data.heading: Passion, persistence and attention to detail.
data.body:
Hadya is a leading real estate development company with active strategic developments across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Our core competencies span the full cycle of residential, hospitality and commercial property development, as well as facility management. Throughout our record, passion, persistence and attention to detail have distinguished our projects — and as we grow, we keep our promise to enrich the society we serve.

Our core competencies span the full cycle of property development — land acquisition, design management, delivery and long-term facility stewardship — with an emphasis on assets we intend to hold and operate rather than simply sell.

items.q: Do you develop for third parties?
items.a: We primarily develop and hold our own assets, though we selectively partner on projects that fit our long-term standards.

items.q: Which cities do you operate in?
items.a: Our current portfolio is concentrated in Jeddah, with strategic developments across the Kingdom.

items.q: Do you manage assets you did not build?
items.a: Yes. Our facility management arm takes on qualified third-party assets where our operating standards can be applied end to end.
